endpoint_definitions.core: accepted RUN to done pulse; equals sum of mutually exclusive categories
endpoint_definitions.export: accepted export start to final output handshake under the TB backpressure pattern

comparison_boundary: not comparable to v7 position-chain latency because the endpoints and scheduled work differ
